answers.core: Since this is also mentioned in the [official GDScript style guide](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/scripting/gdscript/gdscript_styleguide.html#functions-and-variables) I believe there should be an option in the engine by default.
answers.workaround: This could probably be worked around by adding a `push_warning` statement to the setter function of some variables, but this could become cumbersome for scripts containing many private variables.

title: Add optional warnings when accessing properties and methods whose name starts with an underscore from other scripts.
